metadata.description: `DOC-SHELL.json` — the release manifest beside one documentation-shell archive (PROP-057 `##SHELL-RELEASE-ASSET`). It binds one vibe release identity to the exact name, byte count and digest of the separately downloadable shell archive. Source of truth for `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/doc_shell_release_manifest/`.
An exact non-negative byte count. JTD has no uint64 form, so generated Rust narrows the numeric form to u64 and refuses fractions, negatives and overflow.
Lowercase `sha256:<64 hex digits>` digest of the complete archive.
